_comment: WS-5 DYNAMIC 3-lane demo: = sitl3_track_vision.json (convoy_3lane world, 3 diverging straight lanes, bands 2.6/2.4/2.2, all the PROVEN track_convoy tunables) EXCEPT no drone is told which car to chase. Each drone's zone.track_convoy.track_marker_ids is NULL -> track_convoy runs in DYNAMIC mode: it claims whatever ArUco id it SEES that the shared C2 ConvoyRegistry still says is claimable, renews the lock each tracking tick, and the registry's single-winner CAS guarantees two drones never lock one car. The top-level convoy_ids [7,23,88] is the KNOWN set (seeds the registry + the 3-of-3 completion tally); convoy_lock_ttl_s is how long a CLAIMED car survives without a renew before the registry frees it as LOST (a Wi-Fi-drop / drone-loss model) -> another drone may re-claim it. In convoy_3lane each drone spawns directly over ITS lane car (LANES3_POSES) and the cars DIVERGE, so each drone predominantly sees one car and the dynamic claim resolves lane-aligned WITHOUT any hardcoded mapping = the user's sim #3 'drones self-assign, no hardcoded convoy'. Run via sim/run_vision.sh dyn3. Expected evidence: heartbeat shows 3 DISTINCT owners + serviced 3/3; sightings.csv rows > 0 per drone. lock_ttl 12 s = a few track ticks (~0.5 s) + lost_timeout_s (8 s) of slack so a live, tracking drone never self-expires. VM-TUNE car speed / chase aggression / lock_ttl at gate F (same knobs as track3).
